digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — necessity criterion + bug review tier
propositions: Plan-review gate lacks a criterion to detect whether a proposed change is actually needed (FixedBench over-action gap: adding a mechanism without establishing necessity).
Bug tickets currently short-circuit the plan-review gate to bare exempt-PASS with no substantive review (verified on bug 5886: REVIEW_RESULT={runner:exempt, verdict:PASS, llm_calls:0}).

A new pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' detects plans that do not motivate or reproduce the problem, accepting justified no-op/docs-only outcomes (1-TURN plan-text judgment, distinct from asserted-capability).
Bug tickets must stop short-circuiting and instead receive a lightweight advisory review tier consisting of DET floor + necessity probe, never blocking a bug.
Necessity criterion and bug tier ship advisory (never block) and auto-flow to the standing recorder for dogfood-gated promotion to blocking when effectiveness metrics align.
